description: Canadian sales taxes by province or territory (rates in force since 1 April 2025): GST (TPS) + QST (TVQ) in Quebec, GST only in Alberta and the territories, or the single HST (TVH) in Ontario and the Atlantic provinces. British Columbia, Manitoba and Saskatchewan are not covered. Computes tax and total from a pre-tax amount, or the pre-tax amount from a tax-included total (mode "reverse").

amount.description: Amount in CAD: pre-tax (mode "add") or tax-included (mode "reverse")

mode.description: add (default): pre-tax → total; reverse: total → pre-tax

province.description: Province or territory code (QC = Quebec, ON = Ontario...)

name: calculate_canada_sales_tax

result.description: Computed result (fields depend on the tool).

title: Calculate Canada Sales Tax
